text: I like how accessible the game is in terms of complexity, but it'd be nice to have some strategy/skill in catching things and a lot more in battles. For the catching, pokémon always has an aspect of luck but there's almost no skill in just throwing a ball, which makes the luck aspect frustrating because it isn't your fault at all if you fail. It could be fixed by adding other features to the catching sections, but right now it could definitely improve.

The battery is consumed very fast, overheating my phone. Battle passes ruin any sense of reward for playing. Events spam consume basically every weekend now. GoFest is a massive greed event (£50 across 3 tickets plus more to max out Eternatus). The app crashes randomly.

While the app itself is really good, I have to mention some important Issues. First of all, Niantic, the developer, has an extended record of extremely poor decisions that hurt the game and discourage people from keep playing. Secondly, the game isn't free to play friendly. The coins that you earn from gyms are just too few and don't really help you to keep up. Finally, you must be able to walk outside and live in a big city to play effectively. Otherwise, you are at a significant disadvantage.

Overall the game play is great. The side quests and tasks are enjoyable as well as the raid and gym battles. The only real issue I have is the lack of availability of the 'revive' item. When your pokemon are defeated and need to be revived, it would be nice if there were more options to do this. Perhaps the institution of pokemon clinics where for a nominal fee or a number of tasks, you can receive a reward of ×ammount of revives.

It's gotten better actually. It's more of the same except that there's more things to do and more Pokemon to catch! I like the idea of the events! Though I kinda wish the items were fair... I mean, we get loads of items but what's the point of that when we don't have enough bag space. And then what's the point of catching when you don't have enough storage space? I wish there was a way to get free "bags/storage" just like how you can free incubators when you level up. Like it's obvious we're gonna get more Pokemon and Items but it's pointless if we can't store it all!

1. I sometimes have to throw more than 7 poké balls to catch a Pokémon; 2. some of the Pokémon that have appeared on my radar (sometimes several times) have yet to appear on my catch-screen (I feel as though I'm being duped into logging on more often and using incense); 3. I'd appreciate a greater variety of Pokémon; 4. I find the battles to be boring (I might find them to be less boring if they were like those of turn-based RPGs); 5. I'd appreciate if the attack-related graphics were improved.

Pretty boring. You walk around and collect Pokémon. They tend to escape and flee randomly though making the process very frustrating. I walked for a mile and did not see a single Pokémon, but when you start the game it spawns 3-5, making it questionable why you would go out. Raids are inaccessible to all but those who have ~5 friends who play in the same spot. Landmarks are often misnamed and placed in the wrong spot. Eventually I ran out of Pokéballs - I guess the game doesn't want me to play.

It's fun for a little while but it suffers from a lack of depth, and it is a grind. Most Pokémon games have three major components: - Finding and catching Pokémon. - Battling and training Pokémon. - Direct peer-to-peer multiplayer. It would be okay if one of these components were weak or overly simple, but all three of these components are weak and incredibly simple. It would be much better if Pokémon Go shared more characteristics with the Gameboy games.

A great game for a Pokemon fan, has a lot of social potential and works as a great booster to get you moving. The app itself does crash often, almost to a point that its considered normal to have a few crashes per day. When it works its great, but its a shame it doesnt run as a smoothly as it could. It may be down to the phone, but I have a good one and its still the same, overall its great because its Pokemon

I have been playing for many years. Throughout the time, I bought a lot of pokemon points with money. Suddenly, one day, I can't log in anymore. Moreover, on the "Niantic Wayfarer" site, it suddenly says that I'm not eligible, but my account level is higher than 37, and in the past, I submitted pokestops I'm highly disappointed. Worst customer support. Bottom line, they are stealing money.

Its a great game once you get going but a few things would help it: being able to change team - as a person who skipped through the first bit quickly without asking friends what team we are all going to be picked the wrong team. being able to change this ( even willing to pay £1 to do so) would be a great change in the game and help those people who make friends through the game at gyms/pokestops but cant roam with them with being in a different team. unable to battle anything until avg lvl 20+ - you will be doing little to no damage to gyms/raid at this point. any way you could have different gyms/raids show up for under lvl 15's so they can get used to the way the game works. all in all 3/5 but once im able to change teams would help this game and friends a lot.

It's a fun game, but even after being out for two years it's still full of bugs. The most notable problem is the fact that the game often cannot find the GPS, since all the other apps find the GPS just fine its obviously a problem with the game. Since the last update it has gotten even worse to a point where I have to restart the game every few minutes because it suddenly stops being able to find my location.

Game feels like a Beta best case scenario. It now has fewer features than it was released with. I've been plagued by glitches and server issues since the day of release. The tracking feature has no expected return date. Stop making money off of a license and release a proper game. The above was My review on release. With many added features I would say it feels like a fully fledged idea with lots of new content/ events that manage to keep the game engaging.

Good, fun game. Many unlocks are overpriced, as is the store, and although coins can be earned, they are capped at very stingy quantities each day. Clothing items could do with more variation, especially in colour, and in regard to hair ect. Other than that, I can't see any real issues, and have enjoyed my experiences with the game.

I really like the game and I am 're downloading it. One of the reasons it's not 5 star for me is because it takes up a ton of space on my phone and makes it pretty slow. I think a cool feature would be trading posts where u can go there on the map like a shopping mall and u could trade with players who aren't your freinds. Overall I love the game and it's great!!

The Pokemon are designed to break out of the balls frequently, forcing you to use too many balls, just so that you have to buy more from the store - and items are too expensive. Still, it's a great game, fun to play. As well as the network issues and battery consumption, I think one of the improvements it needs is to spawn more Pokemon in rural areas instead of cities, because in the Pokemon universe the creatures are always found outside of towns.

I really love this app, it's very well developed, the animations are beautiful and the graphics are perfect, just one issue though; whenever I try to catch a pokemon, it always said "Camera orientation not found" or something along those lines and I really want to capture them in real life, not just in game. I was wondering if there is a way to fix this?

Great game overall. A couple issues: -When battling a gym, I'll spend time and resources lowering the Pokemon's CP. When the CP is low enough (the last battle before it allows you to add your own Pokemon to the gym), other players will steal the last battle and it appears like they defeated the gym when they only came at the last second. I first started playing this game when it first came out, then went on a long hiatus. Would love to see the next improvements.

So basically I'm a returning player and I have been facing problems with the location thing ... No matter how many times I go to take a walk or drive , but it always shows no distance covered what so ever !!! The need you guys to fix this issue coz I am not getting any things even from taking baby steps in the game its almost frustrating ! Best Regards,

This app is amazing on so many levels. There are a few minor problems about it though. Battling someone can sometimes cause the game to glitch and getting me to lose. And also sometimes when you click on the pokemon the game glitches and says. Error pokemon not found. I am not using any short tricks to catch pokemon. And lastly I think they should do max coins of 75 in stead of 50. But apart from that. This is an amazing app and the events make it even more and more interesting.

I've been having major problems loading the game since last week. I've been informed I'm not the only person having issues & that there is a 'small sub-set' of trainers having the same issue. Whilst Niantic have been keeping me updated with their efforts to resolve the issue I'm still unable to log into my account. I hope they sort it soon. I'm at level 39 (almost 40) & I don't want to have to try & start again from scratch & have wasted a lot of time, money & energy in the process.

11 satellites and (sometimes) they still cant find me. So 4 stars. The game is addictive, very "I want more!" So be prepared to walk to find or meet your goals. OH! just for the record, the app cant tell the difference between walking and running. when I go running, it thinks Im in a car and doesnt log the miles Ive ran!!!! Not good. Also! when you actually are in the passenger side of a car and are passing a stop, be prepared for the pokestop not to recognise you! ARGH!

3 years ago, during the pandemic, niantic made great changes to the game to make it more accessible. Since then, rhey have gone out their way to erode it all, whilst telling everyone "it's for the good of the game". This game is being ruined by niantic. Its a company that refuses to listen to its player base and instead would rather make people play a certain way so they can sell the location data (not individual, but age groups and gatherings)

The game got old quickly. Niantic is too concerned about spoofing and not concerned enough about the content of the game. Provide an in game controller that allows people to wander in a limited radius around their location say 300 meters. This allows for people to be able to play at home or from a safe spot but also allows for them to have get out and go somewhere if they want to change things up.

The game has a solid foundation, catching Pokémon and battling with them is fun. But there are enormous problems with the developers, they seem to care more about how much location data they can extract from you. Their recent changes to prices of items and the frequency of their use is massively anti-consumer and shows the trajectory this game has been on since the pandemic. The game is currently 2 star worthy but I think it may be 1 star soon enough.

Came back on 26/2/19 (Last played early 2018) There's a lot more features that seem to be quite good. Battling so far seems to be both based on your Pokemon's CP and your skill. Their elements do play a part as well. Being up to Generation 4 now is also a win. Now, the reason I've given it a 3/5 (Was 2/5). While there has been an increase in Pokemon spawn rate, I still have to go over 2km to get any form of Pokemon, or stops, or gyms. I unfortunately can't drive for medical reasons.

Recent update is not tracking step outside of app, even though this is meant to be turned on!!! Great game, it's helped me get out more. But it needs more features, like being able to see where clusters of pokestops are, more instructions of how to battle, even being able to heal your pokemon if you put them in a chamber and have to walk 10k like with the eggs. And footprints need to return.

One of my favourite games, even all these years after it came out. Harder to free-play these days. Some small changes I would like to see - pre-populated the pokemon's stats, eg under their name or as a visual bar - remote raid passes more easily attainable again - order of postcards in the book by location/distance from me, so I can see duplicates - order of stickers by 'Most Recent'(ly acquired) and 'Number of Copies', when I'm selecting them for a postcard

I just tried playing for one of the first times since last summer and decided to buy a lucky egg and an incense. They've both been on for ten minutes, but my game apparently can't reach my GPS. So I just wasted real money on the frustration of not being able to play the game. So, I just keep open and closing the app and watching the time for my items drop more and more. Quite unimpressed. Just wanted to get back into the game. And now they are both finished, and I didn't get to use them whatsoever. Except for one rattata... A RATTATA, come on.

Why is it more expensive to purchase larger bundles of coins for less coins? For example, for $0.99 you get 100 coins, but for $13.99 you get only 1200 coins. Usually when you spend more money, you get a better deal! 🤔 Also, it's almost impossible to complete quests (like Meltan) now because you have moved onto new tasks and no longer release the Pokemon needed to complete the quest. For example, we can no longer hatch a Ditto or Areodactyl, so we are just stuck on our current tasks.

In my opinion, this game is an interesting one. I like the idea of walking around to catch pokemon. However, I must say some of the requirements are too high as I play. The reason is - in my place a very few people plays it, as it is very small village. It takes eternity to level up for me, as in my place there are not many Pokémon. The style and non-AR version of the game is perfect for older devices, too! Except for high requirements, I like the gave very much.

The game has got a lot better then when it was first released, but seems to be a lot more bug's and sometimes lag. I personally don't like the pay model but that's business, I know it will never change. I have been playing five years now and I still get a lot of fun out of shiny hunting, an as I work the community days are great for that. So hopefully they will continue to improve the game, an maybe boost the shiny rate for me lol.

Used to absolutely love this game, then after over a year of playing I was unable to load my info unless I was on wifi - and it's a game you play using data - but the game started crashing every 5 minutes as well as camera access being turned off but instead of the steady landscape you instead get a white and hard to balance background. It's difficult to complete the pokedex and some of the missions (which are unskippable) require you to go pokemon hunting with friends - and no one plays on this app anymore because of how buggy and generally bad it is. Honestly, if I could sort the data issue, I would probably still play it. But because there seemingly is no fix for this, I can essentially no longer play.

I've been playing since day 1. Actually, I've been playing even before it was available in my country. Was able to get a pretty complete living dex, including regional forms, costumes, etc. It's been a handful of awesome years playing this game and I was able to meet many people and communities probably wouldn't outside of the game. Unfortunately, these last months have been awful and Niantic's decisions completely ruined the game and I'm uninstalling the game for good. Unreal management.

Niantic(devs) seems to be highly paid gaming experience oriented company as of now. They refuse to hear the players' opinions, so don't come expecting the game to be considerate for the players. Increasing the interaction distance in the game is just one example of many. The earning of pokecoins (in-game currency) was also reduced & limited down to 50 per day to 'encourage' the players to spend money. It's NOT Free-To-Play game with in app purchases, rather the other way round.

The game is enjoyable, BUT hell you do waste a lot of time with minding numbing tasks. For example, you can do 100 trades a day, but each one has to be done separately, you cannot multiple select like you can with emails in your Inbox or photos in your Gallery, who has all that time to waste if you have a bunch of pokemon to trade with a friend, when you want to be catching more! And to take a simple photo of a pokemon involves 6 clicks! If this was a business app it would fail on productivity!

This was a fun, casual game where players could choose to battle at gyms or just collect pokemanz, share pictures and get out, walking to hunt them. But, if you don't have unlimited data, it's difficult to catch pokemanz outside or go to pokespots. The game uses a lot of data and drains my battery very quickly. Still, the game has improved a great deal.

Your app could list the installed software you believe violates the terms of service. The "Your device is not compatible" message is a passive-aggressive method. My device is not rooted though I eventually figured out I had a copy of SuperSU installed. Just tell us what needs to be removed? Be upfront about it. Giving you 1 star for hours wasted troubleshooting. Please add an extra error message or an incompatible app list on your support site!! Would be a 4 star game otherwise.

I installed the game again after 2 years without playing. I stopped playing because of the Raid system where I would never be able to find players in my city to play the raids with and the difficulty to get gold to actually move forward. If this is still an issue, I'm glad to find a league system, the team Rocket and other new good things. This is actually starting to look like a real life Pokémon adventure. Some day I'll get my Feraligatr 🤤

This version does not work on my phone, keeps telling me it's not compatible! It was fine less than a month ago, this bug needs to be fixed. It's driving me crazy and has been getting worse daily, can't trust it to stay on long enough to catch a Pokemon let alone go between apps. Today it has stopped more times than I can count, and that's just from the times it managed to open. Opening alone sometimes take about 5 to 10 attempts!

Lots of glitches unfortunately. When I catch something it will freeze, a white line at the bottom of the app about a half inch covering almost all of the bottom icons. When I'm a passenger in a car, even if we are going like 10km, often the pokestop will spin but tells me to try again. All extremely annoying. Everything else is fun, besides the glitches.

Great until there is a glitch. Have tried emailing support twice only to get an automated email saying I have to report the bug in app.... problem is I can not get the app to open. Went to my local Pokémon go Facebook page to see if anyone else is having the issue or has had and what they did. Tried it and still will not let me open the game.... I would hate to lose my progress or worse not be able to play anymore. Not sure what else to do if I can't email support and can't report bugs in app.

Decided to return to Pokemon Go after not playing it for a year. From the get go, I wasn't able to login due to the app apparently needing to be updated, and it booting me to the Google Play store. The only issue being, I installed the latest version of the app from the store in the first place... Cue a cycle of frustration as I attempted to keep logging in and the game booting me out. Story your game up, niantic!!

Amazing game! This app has come so far since it started. There are events, raid bosses, spotlights for pokemon and much more! My only issue with this game is that sometimes it will say, "You're going too fast", like it does when you're a passenger in a vehicle playing when I'm walking around lol. And it glitches during Raid Boss catching once in a while, which is frustrating. No game crashes. They've done great work to adjust the game to COVID-19 safety! All in all, a fantastic game to play!

Honest Review of Pokémon Go: Brilliant time waster when outside. Uses quite a bit of battery, even with "battery saving" mode. Way too many micro transactions. If you're disabled, in quarantine or simply unable to go outside, you can't do much but catch the same small amount of Pokémon that spawn near your house. There should be some sort of control from within your home. Servers are terrible. Lag and the very common "unable to authenticate" error requires you to reinstall the game every time.

The quality of a lot of things have gone down over the years especially a really annoying glitch during PvP where trainers can make use of three shields rather than the standard two. When submitted a report they blame it on 'latency issues' but this issue has been going on for more than two years with no resolution which is frustrating as a player. The things in the store have become more expensive as well and the free daily gift box always gives the same items.

I usually never write reviews, but I am writing this, hoping things can change. After two weeks of playing Pokémon GO for the first time in years, it is really hard for new players to start in the game if they are not spending huge amounts of time and money. For those two weeks, I have been struggling to always have any space left in my backpack or in my pokemon storage. As well as some of the research tasks are impossible without someone to play with (ex. the party one). Please fix the game...

I wish I could rate this lower than 1 Star with Niantic's recent decisions. Obviously the majority of the profit they make is off of selling the users location and data (which is the whole point of "Adventure Sync" and allowing the app to track your location); but, the amount that Niantic has gutted fun features and functions for the actual player base is mind-boggling. It shows that they don't care about the Pokémon franchise, the player base. They care about your location and data

Infuriating to use. I keep getting kicked out and automatically signed out because the game "can't connect to server", even when my phone has a strong internet connection. I'm forced to sign in again, but it can never authenticate my information. It never says I entered anything incorrectly, just that it can't authenticate. I'm forced to reset my password every time. Niantic, get yourself together.

Having an absolutely awful experience. On top of the 10+ minute wait times, it white-screens whenever I go to catch a pokémon. I went to change my username (as I had an old account) and I had to reload 5+ times. The keyboard would not open as I went to change my username and when it did, it would close the keyboard after typing one letter. Not worth it on android - I've tried to download it on an alternate device so we'll see how that goes.

Ahead of the release of this game there were alot of different features that were promised to be delivered only a short amount of time (some months) after the release of the game. Features such as Trainer vs Trainer, Common Loot System for every Trainer no matter the Trainer's current cordinates, a gamestyle where you can team up and make friends with your Pokémon and a great story you can relate to. None of these things have come out yet, and that's why the game is loosing interest.

To be honest, I waited for three years after release and tested the app on four different devices before I could eventually play and it was definitely worth the wait 😁 really enjoying, I was just hoping maybe for an update where Pokemon that have enough candies to evolve are highlighted when you view all your Pokemon, it would make it so much easier than having to sit, sort and go through each and every one (btw, I have about 200 so far), please please consider it, I think it would help a ton.

The game is more fun now when they made more Pokémon spawn in suburban areas. The thing I don't like is the combat. Very tedious, boring and repetitive with just tapping and dodging. If they made it so that you could collect TMs and learn your Pokémon moves when reaching a certain CP, it'd make the game so much more worth to be fighting gyms as well as adding more stuff to collect and show off to your friends.

The game has a huge focus on micro transactions, the more you pay the better you play. As a result the game suffers unnecessarily from it. I don't mind paying for a game, but the current model is terrible. A subscription would be a much better payment model. The recent decision to revert some of the more than year long covid related changes in the name of profit at the cost of, not only enjoyment of the game, but also the safety of the game, has prompted me to make this 2 star review.

Horrible! This has happened so much that I decided to write this review. I always have an issue with the app hanging and freezing at the loading page. This has been like this at least 2 years now! And I've given up on this game. If Niantic wants people to give this a good rating, better get your issues together. Oh and it's super laggy too. I'm using OPPO F1s. There are only a few good days where they app runs really smooth. This is not worth my time anymore.

I enjoy playing. I am disappointed that our pokemon cannot get better by fighting in the gyms, I want more varied options for my character, I want pokemon battles to look more like the game (or a strategy type game would be awesome) and my phone keeps freezing up while I walk or when I'm catching pokemon, requiring endless restarts. Hopefully, this new update will take care of some of those issues.

It's actually a good game, but there are some things that need to be fixed. If you attack a gym and clear two rounds alone, and in the last round, there is another player fighting with you from another team, then you may have to wait for them to place their Pokémon first, even though you started the gym fight first. It's quite frustrating because then you have to clear the gym again. And if you have no luck, other players come and place their Pokémon, so you have to battle more Pokémon.

At this stage, the game has no storyline. Its only objective is to collect as many pokemon as possible. Controlling gyms offers the opportunity to collect a tiny number of in-game currency, but that's it. There's quite a few game features related to walking distance, but the game still can't track walked distance properly.

pokemon go is essentially unplayable now. all vehicle (high speed) play is entirely eliminated which is where the game was most playable originally. On top of that, ever since the beginning, the game was useless if you didn't live in a major city because you would never see any pokemon around where you lived. I'm not sure how the issues it originally had were never fixed but its actually gotten worse over time. This game needs a major overhaul and a re tooling if it's ever going to be any good.

It's fun, but the pricing is interesting. Most games on the market will give you discount when you buy in game currency which means the more you buy the cheaper it cost per unit. To pretend they care for your wallet. For example, if you pay $1 for 100 coins and for 1200 coins, instead of paying $12 usually you pay less let's say $11. But in Pokemon GO, you pay $1 for 100 coins, and for 1200 coins, you pay $15, which is more expensive. They don't even pretend! They want it bad!

I played for a few days here (after 2 year hiatus) and I will be putting it down forever. The pay-to-win portion of this game is out of control. This game has diversified in so many things to keep things competitive and incentivise buying stuff in the shop to keep your edge. All we wanted was a real world pokemon where you walk, catch, train, & fight Pokemons. Shame on you Niantic.

October 2018 Edit: Pokemon Go has come a long way. Niantic seemed to wise up at some point and started actually talking to their customers. There has been a lot of good new content added to the game. There are still a few big issues with the game (battle system, gym system, performance, etc), but overall its pretty good right now. OLD EDIT: After seeing that concerns over the increased difficulty in catching Pokemon are being confirmed, yet still receiving zero communication from Niantic on anything at all, I have decided to drop my review down to 1 star. I cannot recommend anyone play this game, as it seems very clear that Niantic is only in it for the money and doesn't care about producing a product that is good for the player, only themselves. **Original review follows** This game could be an easy 5 star, but unfortunately due to unforeseen difficulties the developer is facing, and much more importantly the total lack of willingness on the part of the developer to communicate with their customers, this game is too much of a risk for me to feel good about encouraging people to play and spend money on this game. There are certainly some cool parts about this game, but without any reassurances on the part of the developer that they have heard the concerns of the players and are working to repair the problems currently in the game, I cannot in good conscience give this game a higer rating than 2 stars. Hopefully Niantic will realize that people are unhappy and correct their mistakes.

If you're playing this game ensure you have phone data to spare! Big data and battery hog. My only real complaint in regards to gameplay is the amount of time it takes to collect in-game currency. Of course the app needs to make money somehow, but only 50 coins can be gathered a day from gyms, making the process of collecting coins to expand the inventory (VERY necessary) quite tedious. Otherwise lots of fun, and a great motivator for getting some exercise in your day-to-day!

Firstly, the game wanted to update while I was casually taking over a gym. It's the closest gym to my house. The game wouldn't let me play until I updated, which took about twenty minutes. From then on I can't even open the app, it just stays on the loading screen. I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app, and I've also restarted my phone, but nothings working. The game was actually good before this. I genuinely love the game, but now I can't play, which is lowkey depressing.

The idea behind this game is revolutionary but Niantic Labs is rather incapable of implementing it well or lack the knowledge and resources to do so. When this game came out in 2016, it was a blast to play. The game had something incredibly new and fresh to offer. Though it had very limited gameplay features, it was overlooked as the game was fairly new. But now, even though 2 years have passed, the developers have failed to add something new except and few generations of new Pokemon, trading, raids and "Daily Tasks" and missions to keep their daily login numbers up. The game is very area biased so good luck playing this game if you live in an isolated part of the world.

Good game. Very fun and it does an awsome job of getting you out and about going on adventures. Even if your just stuck inside on a booring day, you can do remote raids or trainer battles. I've been playing this for years now. Every now and then I get GPS signal glitches but they fix in a few days. I think it would be cool to see a 2v2 mode come to the game some time soon though. Pokemon fashion shows would be pretty cool to see in the game too. Overall I rate it 4/5

Please create a rule so that players cannot take over a gym they have just been kicked out of within a certain amount of time. We have one local player who will appear (driving) within minutes of being kicked out of a gym, no matter the time of day, or location in our town, and take the gym back. It is making the game boring for other players, who are no longer getting any joy out of taking over gyms, and I will stop playing soon if this continues.

Have been playing since the game came out and never experienced any issues - until now. The latest update has screwed the game for me. I can no longer catch pokemon. If I have AR turned on I can't catch anything no matter how hard I try, and when I turn it off the game freezes and I have to force stop on the app. I have a OnePlus phone with Android. Please please fix this!!

Fun enough to play for a grind-based game, but there are plenty of bugs and support are notoriously unhelpful so beware. I had free items simply disappear over time which I let slide, but when a paid-for rare item failed to be added to one I'd keeping for months, Niantic refused to acknowledge that 1+1=2 and kept me at 1, despite agreeing I hadn't used one in recent history and claiming the new one had been added. So enjoy it, have fun, but don't expect to be respected by the developer.

Tracker update, lack of communication, shut down of 3rd party apps, curve ball bonus removal. A lot of the things that made this game good have been thrown out of the window. EDITED IN 2019: The game has eventually gotten so much better and I have amended my review to reflect that. Its infinitely more stable than it was at release, trading, friends, raids and more pokemon than ever, while fixing pokemon tracking and the many bugs that were plaguing it in the beginning.

Like many others, I started this game in 2016 and dropped out of it just as the bugs continued to happen around that time. I came back to pogo in 2018 and had a blast till 2022. The game became stale. Remote raid passes because more expensive and limited and some players just don't use money for the game. Grinding in gyms was already hard enough. Disappointed that I will miss the friends I've made around the world. You know when was the best time for pogo? During covid. Use those updates.

Greedy slimballs. Uninstalling game right now, I play the game mostly in the summer, as a way to get active. But the changes to the remote raids basically makes it unsustainable to play in the winter. If they wanted more activity in person, they could have left it at the 5 limit. But the fact that they raised the price, shows their intentions is greed. No consideration for players and different communities and region or safety. It's a global game, excludes major chunks of the population.

This is one of the best mobile games ever made. However it is not perfect, one problem I, and many others I know has is the types of pokemon in our area. I RARELY get anything other than pidgeys, ratattas and spearows and nothing else. Please could you increase the chance of getting better and rarer Pokemon as I get nothing but the same boring things. Also could you also add something that shows you the pokemon in that area rather than the sightings thing? Its kinda annoying.

Good game. I like the feeling of being able to catch Pokémon in real life, but there are a few things which mess it up for me. Pokémon don't spawn randomly anymore, only in specific locations. This makes it harder if you live nowhere near any pokéstops. Also, only higher leveled players can catch higher cp Pokémon, which annoys me because my friend is lv 26 and I'm only level 12. Overall the game is good, but a few changes should be made.(:

It's fun at the start, you get new pokemon and keep going up and up the levels.. Then you get gyms to win money. But the problem is that the potion drop on pokestops are too rare, and sometimes I know leveling up gives you potions, but it's clearly not enough. And then you've certainly done the error of using all your incubators. The game wants you at some point to pay what you need. When you reach level 20, you see that you never get new pokemon, they're always the same ones.The game gets boring

I have been a dedicated player for many years, even though not everything has been as fun, like the first few years, I have continued to play daily! I have spent money and time all to have my Account hacked, and because I got 1 or 2 questions (questions that many can get incorrect!) I am no longer valid to confirm I am the owner of my own account, even if I present payment informations, pokemon and more. tried customer support, several times, all get told to make a new account... Just horrible

This game has a lot of pull, it's pokemon, it's a GPS driven game that encourages you to get out and about. But, it's also a neolib nightmare, each update has something to encourage purchases. This is a company making over a billion in revenue from a server stack, an app and an IP licence. They don't need to keep rinsing their base or making gameplay harder for rural, disabled or immobile players. I really like the game, but the direction of development isn't great, but they keep making money...

It has been 4 years since the game released and numerous features have been added such as raiding, trading and PvP. On the downside, Niantic has proven to be an incompetent and greedy company, introducing new bugs every update and not resolving bugs that have been around for ages, while also delaying or even blocking player progress behind a paywall. The game is great if you're a fan of Pokémon or have a group of friends/good community to play with. Otherwise, steer clear from this cash grab.

My old review was a little bitter and is now out of date, so here's a new one. I love the game and log in many times daily. Mostly due to my love of pokemon. The game has made me get more exercise, visit new places and make new friends, so it's achieved what the developers want. However, there are too many little issues that stop it getting 5* Mostly its trivial stuff, but there's enough of it to make it add up.

A fairly simple treasure hunting game that has opened up a whole new concept in mobile gaming. It's let down a little by the GPS battery drain so get an external battery pack. Trading, gifting friends and legendary Pokemon have all been added since launch. When in a new place following the stops takes you to lots of points of interest that you might otherwise miss. I can see this concept working for other franchises and I'm excited to see what comes next. Currently a good way to get out of the house.

Was a 5* game but Niantic have run the game into the ground. The game has been profusely limited in what you can do daily, or weekly. It has turned into a complete and utter pay to win game except the prices have skyrocket as well, and even then they have put a cap on how many raids you can do. With these new changes they have basically cut rural players, disabled players and players who have busy lives from the game point blank. I have uninstalled, and I certainly wouldn't recommend.

malfunctioning GPS is one thing, and not letting us log in is another, but to not even load the game and just stuck at the Niantic screen? This is a new low for an update error. I thought I've seen the worst this game has to offer, but turns out I'm wrong. I guess I won't be playing and discovering the new Sinnoh Pokémon and evolutions for a while.

Well, this is a great idea for a Pokemon game to have people going outside! But, the problem is that, in the new trading system, it costs way too much stardust, even as you level up friendship level, especially shinies, legendaries and new Pokemon. I would understand if it were around 50000-75000 stardust for good friends, but it is so much more! Also we need to implement trading items, please.

The game itself is very good, but when you want to log back in or create another account, it keeps asking you for an "adult" email address for a child account, but as soon as you want to create your adult account, they still show you have to enter a parent's email address. It's illogical and totally annoying. I wanted to play again for the nostalgia, but the desire quickly disappeared as soon as I struggled for more than 15 minutes. So good luck.

The lack of servers is astounding. This is a detriment to the Pokémon reputation. Error messages left and right. The only consistent thing is the game crashes. Thank you for ruining my favourite childhood TV Series and game. (2016) Edit: Three years later, the game runs super smooth. No errors or crashes encountered in three months of consistently using the software. Glad to see it has switched around.

I'm extremely frustrated and disappointed. I accidentally pressed the sign out button and then I fully remember my password and username so I really thought it was okay. So I typed my password and username. BUT it kept telling me that it's unable to authenticate. Our wifi is pretty bad so I thought that's the case, but it wasn't. I've tried it multiple times, it's been four days now. I was definitely sure I entered the right password and username. But I also thought maybe it's wrong, so I tried to reset my password. And I did. After undergoing the procedures, I was able to change my password. So I went back to the game and inputted it. BUT it still says the same thing! I really love this game, but now my data is lost. If you can fix this problem, then I will be back and rate 5 stars for that.

Used to not get many issues with it but now it's a nightmare. The AR isn't working - screen just goes black and I can't go back, I have to close the app and reopen it. Also now it just keeps freezing when I do anything. Pokemon pop up around and if I click one the screen just goes white and freezes. It's being a super nightmare. Hope you guys get these glitches sorted out asap

Broken update upon broken update. Late event activation upon late event activation. Niantic continue to fail to do the basics right. This game has been out for almost 5 years now, and the recent update has put the game into a near unplayable state with copious amounts of lag in the GBL, frame rate drops, freezes and more. If you are one of the lucky ones that didn't update (my device auto updated), do not update update until niantic acknowledges and fixes the problem.

Fix Routes and daily adventure incence Routes Auto Pause and Galarian birds don't even come after 50 tries. I have been trying strategies from going on routes to doing it at specific times to no avail. I still have 2 Master Balls in my bag not used. Routes are ridiculous, 250 Zygarde cells is impossible and routes auto pause every second you are more than 1 meter off. The in game purchases are crazy; $1.50 AUD for something you can get in 30 minutes. Terrible Game, Don't Download it. 👎👎👎

I have been frustrated after playing this game. It's a very time consuming game.Takes lots of time to login. I have to try 5-6 time for login. Because of it's worst server it takes a lots of time to authenticate. After lots of hardworking while I got some Pokemon then the server stopped working and I have been logged out from the game automatically and the problem persists after the updation also. It's a really frustrating game.

I install it and I can open it and make an account fine. Then the game starts. All good, right? Nope! Charmander, Squirtle, and Bulbasaur glitch into one character, and I can't catch them. There is no way for me to catch them. I have spent the last two days trying to solve this, but it's just a bug that can't be fixed for me, unfortunately. Don't waste time installing. Until this bug is fixed my star rating remains as is.

After sometime playing, i will tell you what is missing in this game: in-game map STRANGER trainer's APPEARANCE! and an in-game list of nearby stranger trainers! Let us find each other in the game map, we can introduce our self in that not through a web so if a trainer we don't know pop up nearby(display in map), we can tap each other and make friends! a lot of players just don't go through webs to find Pokémon-go friends you know, do this so we can approach nearby future friends!

Brilliant game nowadays! Hotspots seem to of disappeared and pokémon seem to be more random and only influenced by weather (shame not by location either e.g. fight types by local fitness gyms). Only other criticism would be raid battles are just too hard solo either by health or time, and it's hard to find gyms where other people are ready for the raid at the same time (basically only good if you got pokémon go buddies with you). It should adjust the difficulty accordingly to player count.

Please sort whatever is stopping S20 users from playing!! We're missing out on everything you're doing to help us during lockdown :( I'd also suggest some way to prevent wasting items when your bag is full, either selling them for coins to use in the shop, or using them for gifts instead- being able to customise gifts with it would be cool! And it can be randomised to prevent bias i.e. people giving certain friends all their best stuff. It'd be a lot more helpful!

Uninstalled, the game gets worse and more expensive every day, they seem to keep taking things away because God forbid you have too much fun. There's also many annoying QoL things they could easily change, for example, the freind and raid notifications you get Pop up at the top of the screen and get in the way of other buttons so I need to wait for the notification to go away and sending and receiving gifts is tedious and more - a game has never made me hate a set of devs so much. Disappointing.

There's been a lot of issues popping up for a while now, even before the go fest. But now after the recent update I can't even play where I am or even if I go outside. The game with acts as if I'm commiting taboo, character lags behind even for miles on end when I'm already far away from where the game thinks I am or it never finds my location. It also sometimes makes it impossible to catch raid or shadow Pokemon since the textures get all messed up as if the were from Minecraft.

The good: It's fun to collect all the pokemon, It's great to be outdoors and explore, doing raids with friends is enjoyable. The bad: Battles are childishly simplistic with few moves and teams of only 3, CP caps are arbitrary, Atk, def, and spd stats are poorly explained, stardust takes an obscenely long time to collect, even with active bonuses, the game is extremely grindy, & the whale fishing microtransaction store. Overall: Play for the collection aspect. Nothing else is very substantial.

An enjoyable timesink, even if a little grind-ey, and neat way to play a Pokémon game. However, the most recent patch forces you to always have your GPS on and location known to the game in order for your steps to be counted whilst the app is closed (a large part of the game when it comes to hatching eggs and earning candy.) Why this was implemented I have no idea as it used to be perfectly fine by using the step counter built into the phone. Until this is reverted I have deleted the game.

Excellent game, have played it since release. Yes there have been bugs and what not but still a great game. Only reason for 4 stars is that the Pokémon go plus notification is not there anymore when it's connected which is a real pain and even though they say you can now swipe to remove the in game notifications s it doesn't work. Hopefully this will be fixed in the next update

The gameplay is fantastic, but I spend more time trying to get into my account than actually playing the game. Whenever I try to start it on mobile data it says "Failed to log in". Also it's full of bugs and cannot be used in the kind of place where you won't crash into people all the time because there isn't data in that place. Don't install, it'll only frustrate you.

Thank you so much about creating this game for I'am a pokemon fan. I gave the game 4 stars because I think there are still missing features specifically about chatting. For instance, it is more fun to just chat another friend in this app and it is also great if there is a worldwide chat where players can talk to each other. Also it is more convenient to see the trainer code below the name. it is useful if my friend wants to be his/her friend. Thank you so much and I hope you'll think about it.

With all of the latest content updates this is by far the best AR game around. There's plenty to do if you're willing to walk for it! Battling, trading, collecting; it's all finally in the game, to make this the most realistic pokemon simulator out there. You don't have to spend any money to play and the upcoming online league and leaderboards make this game a must have.

This game relies heavily on tracking your gps location (for hatching eggs or collecting candies) and yet the gps is inaccurate and awful. You can walk 15km and the game will say you've walked only a fraction of that. Very difficult to advance in the game without expending more energy, data and battery life than necessary. It's frustrating and takes away from the fun experience of gaming. With proper updates I think it would be better.

I used to play this on my old iPhone 5c before it stopped being able to update due to that model being outdated. Now I have an android and was so excited to get the game again, and everything was going well, until I had to actually catch a pokemon. Basically, despite allowing access to location services, the GPS doesn't work in game, so I can't play it at all. All my other apps work fine with location services, and uninstalling and reinstalling the app hasn't helped, nor has any other attempt.

This is an arranged game, especially for sending pokemon to Pokemon Home. Easy catches for starter allow you to send them to whatever game needed, this is brilliant when trying to do the Pokedex, so the game has it's ups and downs, what one person might need it for others might want to for different stuff especially when travelling to find alternative pokemon. Given this game, 3 out of 5 rating as I think it could have more features. Cheers for reading!

Price changes and quality of life keep going in the wrong direction. The developers should be creating more ways to include people, not make it more difficult for us to play. Keeping a community happy and investing in them pays off with long-term success rather than trying to squeeze out short-term gains. Pokémon go already makes it difficult to access much of its content and people have chosen to invest in it. However, the game doesn't get more challenging, it just keeps getting more expensive.

Glitching from the moment I opening the newly installed app. The game will not activate to allow me to catch the starter pokemon. The character just stands there and does nothing so I cannot begin to play the game, it froze many more times in the opening story parts of the game. The game is far worse than it was when it first came out. Was really looking forward to playing it on my new phone which has far more memory and processing power than my last one yet I cannot get the app to work at all.

Niantic's customer service to paying customers is pathetic. I got double billed for a purchase that I made through a bug. All attempt to contact Niantic redirected me to contact them through the in game support. I attempted to the do this, but the app crashes. When I did get through, Niatic refused to refund this double bill. It's go to know that's when you need help in this game, Niatic won't be there. My lesson is not spend money with the app at all, and save the disapointment.

Very addictive game. No wonder it bloomed in the community when it first ce out. The only things that ruined the gameplay for me is the catch mechanics. It is just so frustrating when that slight little flick will send the ball flying to who knows what. And the catch rate that I had to deal with some pokemon is just Ridiculous. As an example, I tried to catch a Caterpie with a great ball the other day, it didn't even take one cycle for it to get out. A fricking Caterpie!

Don't start playing this game. This should be one of the greatest mobile games of all time, but Niantic has over monetized and under delivered at every opportunity. They stumbled upon the golden goose and have been making incompetent attempts to kill it for almost three years. The latest of their bumblings has been a predatory price increase in remote raid passes. The past three years have been awash with terrible decisions that shows utter contempt for the game's players. I should stop playing.

The loading time just to get into the game is too long and the catch rate is a struggle even though have plenty of PokeBalls and when the spawn rate of a shiny Pokemon, as well as trying to complete quests just to finish them is a outrage, let alone the price of the stuff in the shop is a bit pricey...other than that it's a fun game and enjoy it while working

This game is nicely balanced in that you can play it seriously and build a team of awesome Pokémon to battle with, or you can dip in every so often to add to your collection, or anything in between. It's constantly being updated and expanded, and for a game that's designed to get you out in the world they've done a great job of dealing with lockdowns and keeping it playable. Plus it's free with no adverts, and you can easily play without buying anything if you want. It's awesome :)

original 5 star review: this game is amazing. I have met so many people out in the world playing it. I have never seen anything like this. absolutely amazing. not without its faults, I looks forward to updates that add trading and battles and for the bugs to be worked out. . . UPDATED REVIEW: still come back to this from time to time. it's a classic Game and it's not a skateboarding game.

Game is good but the developer seems determined to ruin it for players. The amount of time and money I invested seems totally wasted now. I've played it since the very start but if I knew then what I know now... My advice? Don't bother downloading it. Hyper exclusive, for able bodied players who live in a large urban environment, with plenty of time on their hands and are lucky enough to have an active local group. If you don't fall into ALL the above categories don't bother, you are excluded

*UPDATED- WORKING ON NEW DEVICE* Phone not rooted, running correct OS. Been playing since UK launch, worked on my device previously but suddenly not compatible. Was already battling issue of only being able to sign on over WiFi not data, so when out of Wifi range & the game invariably glitches, freezes, throws me off the server I then can't login unless I go find a WiFi connection, which isn't always easy in a rural location. I'm wheelchair user too, which makes the game harder for me as it is.

It was a good game until they niantic started money grabbing, they up the price of in game purchases and then update the game avatars to look like a bunch of flat looking, colourless bots, they literally have the money to do so much more and yet they are downgrading not upgrading the gameplay, The acuracy when getting the catch circle perfect is so out and has been for a while now. Its just getting worse, the further up in levels you go the more they stop your account from encountering shinys.

I've decided today that if ANY task is time limited, I'm no longer interested. I don't care if it is only a dollar, or more likely more as Niantic seek to screw ever more money out of players. I'm not buying in. I was probably 100 metres short if hatching an egg, but didn't. Result the task finished before I'd had chance to finish. No fault of my own, I just have a life beyond Pokémon and had other things to do. I want tasks that I can complete in my own time. I'm no longer paying to fail.

It's a fun game that will give purpose to your walks. Has quite a few flaws, like the data usage or sometimes it doesn't allow you to login (bad connection?), but none keeps me from playing. Collecting Pokémons, trying to keep the best and when you find friends: trading the less brilliant. It has a nostalgic aspect for those who played the games in Game Boy like me. It's casual, entertaining, it has events that keep you walking on the streets for hours and it will make your friends whine because you're playing this instead of giving them attention. I recommend.

Not too shabby. Should have the option to add Pokestops at certain locations. To avoid an over abundance of them, have them come at a hefty price where communities can get together and purchase one. Extra money in your pockets. Have a website setup where people can create a funding pool for a specific area for a new stop. Just an idea.

I love this game and play it daily. There's a lot that can be better though. I get a lot of gps signal errors, which can be very frustrating, especially when waiting in the lobby for a battle. If I'm using a remote pass it's extra frustrating. I also wish the avatars were more customizable! There's a huge opportunity for Pokémon go to make some money but instead they come out with silly back packs or boring wrist watches. Let's get some new hairstyles, body types, etc.

NOT DISABILITY FRIENDLY, also I have loved this game and have been playing almost every day since its release, but the price increases are getting ridiculous. I was spending almost £10 every month just to have a somewhat good gaming experience, with the recent price hike it's looking more like £20 now. I'm lucky I live near a city though, if I was a rural player it would cost a fortune. It's clear now that this game is nothing more than a cash grab on niantics part.

The game: 5/5. The app: 0/5. An amazing concept, but extremely poorly coded. I've been playing since it launched and in all that time I don't believe I've *ever* got through an entire session without having to restart the app because of a freeze or crash. And even when it's not outright falling over, it's buggy as hell.

Update to my review. After nearly 9 years of playing the game my account was hacked, due to being a casual player I couldn't give them specific details like events I had done or clothing items I owned and they told me to just start again. I can still see my account via my partners friends list. I wouldn't recommend wasting your time.

I was player from the very beginning but then stopped for 2 years. Now that i am back I have to say it became much more fun and smooth! I only wish spawning would have a little bit more variety. Otherwise smooth game play, fun research and special events! Ps. I adore the way the current situation is handled and all the changes dev's are trying to make the game enjoyable even during these times.

The big problem with the game in its current form is that it includes none of the puzzle solving that made the original games great. The sole game mechanic is collecting Pokémon, every quest is just about collecting X number of Pokémon or using X number of berries or performing X number of great throws. The lack of variety leads to the game getting very repetitive very quickly and the introduction of new Pokémon to collect does nothing to assuage this.

One minute I'm playing and can close the game and reload the next I can't. Game will not load so I can not play it. The game loads on my son's phone but soon as I try it the loading gets half way and stops, it is very frustrating as one minute it's fine the next it says no. What gets me the most is that I can do 6 days in a row spinning and catching but then the game won't load on the 7th day so I loose out! I try log out and log in only for it to tell me it was unable to authenticate it and won't le me log in. I've also noticed no matter how much I write bad things not 1 person from the app has tried to help me!

Love the game...but I seriously hate that now you MUST point the camera around to see/find the Pokemons...i miss the old times..you could play both with and without pointing the camera around :(((( I'm not sure how to rate the game...love it and hate it at the same time... Played it so much but had to quit due to weak device for a long time... really wish we could pick if we want to use the old ways or not.

It's a great game for both Pokémon fans and newbies to the IP. It's fun to walk around, catch and shiny hunt. The situation around the pandemic got Niantic to move in several ways, both good and bad. They increased spawns in general, added the ability to raid remotely, adapted quests and challenges so players are mostly able to do them from home. With this however, Niantic got insanely greedy, requiring us to buy a new kind of raid pass and more and more content gets locked behind a paywall.

A few things that would greatly improve gameplay for me: 1) Better graphics. Like, seriously, our characters are walking on a rudely coloured map. There are green fields and roads and flat squares. In a 3d game. Come on. 2) Character customization. Let's give our chars a unique hairstyle, hair colour, face, height,... make us look less generic. 3) Pokemon fights. Let us have actual Pokemon fights instead of tapping, and a chance to battle NPCs or other players even if the own team is below 2000cp. Gyms at my place are completely impossible for a low level player. 4) See other nearby players in-game. Okay, maybe just noone in my city is playing Pokemon go anymore, but if there are and it's just a missing feature: Let me see their avatars if they are nearby. 5) Pokemon and pokestops in rural areas.

Great game but buggy, non working additions. There's a "new" ( out for about a month ) addition called routes where you have to follow a determined route created by another player. And there's 1 of the issues, there are absolutely 0 routes for me and for the majority of the player base. AND if there are routes, then they don't work, they pause for no reason and then keeps getting you to walk backwards and forwards until you've had enough and just cancel it. Otherwise the game is great and fun.

Great game but getting tired of server troubles, unknown errors, unable to log in warnings etc. Definitely would not spend money on this. Update: still quite repetitive but added more events and larger catalogue of pokemon to obtain. Still alot of grinding required to beat certain goals and level up but common amongst a lot of free to play games.

There are too many bugs, crashes, glitches etc. This is not yet a completed application. Fix it! 3 years later its still incomplete, buggy, grindy, regional. Impossible to make progress if you play alone in areas where the game is dead. They took a great brand and franchise with huge potential and ruined it.

This game has so much potential, but as with many other companies it's clear that Niantic doesn't care about the players in the slightest. Everything is about the bottom line for them. They "graciously" gave us "bonuses" for the pandemic, which in reality were just improvements that made the game worth playing again. Now they're removing them all and proving that Niantic is completely blind to the changes that the pandemic made to the world. They don't want us to play- they want to make money.

I really enjoy this game, but for me it has one huge drawback. The lack of Pokémon and pokestops in rural areas. In order to play I have to get a lift or bus to the nearest city or town, which are about ten miles and twenty miles away respectively. I think it would help greatly if more Pokémon spawned in smaller villages and if there were pokestops at more churches/church ruins and maybe even the local airfield. I'd be a bit more of a serious player if I could just walk outside and head out along the foot paths finding Pokémon like a do in the city.

The latest versions have been much improved. The game is now smoother and more fun to play, especially with the additions of trading and friends. Only issues I'm currently having are occasional glitches with a Pokémon 'stuck' in a ball when signal drops, and some days when the GPS seems dodgier than others. Now we just need a breeding mechanic and some kind of friend locator ability :)

This game started out really well, despite the server issues. Needless to say since the game launched Niantic has made A LOT of money, and yet they still choose to change the game in ways which make the player spend more money to play. This is just obvious greed on their part. Nevermind the removal of tracking, they just want you waste all of your pokeballs on low level spawns and fork out your cash for more balls. 2 million dollars in game purchases wasn't enough for them...

Wanna know why 1 star rating cause it's too location dependent. I love where literally almost no one plays it . So if I want to play either i need to spoof or I need to change where I live like bruh not at all friendly for casual plays. It should have been a relaxing experience but instead it's searching for any one who plays or using multiple devices to play. The new Gmax update wasn't help in the slightest. Give something for us who play in remote areas too. Niantic too disappointing

I live in a rural area. Absolutely no pokestops, gyms or pokemon around my house. I'm relegated to playing on my breaks and lunch at work. I know they're constantly adding more stuff, but it still seems like 99.99% of those are in places that already have them, just adding more. A way to fast track additions for places that have NOTHING would really help and would bump this up to 5 stars IMO.

This app is not for people in wheelchairs. or for people who can't get out of their house because of certain disease. Some people might say, they dont have to play, but they deserve to do everything, a normal does. Gotta say, I'm little disappointed. If only they had enabled the feature to roam within the app, and not by actually moving. Then it might get more players and more good ratings. Due to inability of providing in-app movement to catch pokemons, make this app less likeable now.

This game is really good and engaging. Quite addictive also. You don't have to spend money to keep on in this game as compared to others. But, i feel this game is lacking a chat system. I mean we sure can add others players in friend list but there's no way to communicate with them in game. All you can do is to send them gift, trade and battle. For which they have to live near you. They should add some features so, we can play and have fun with players all around the world.

Very pathetic . When I started game it looked bit disappointing, the graphics are bad , it's looks like some imatures made this game. Nothing is perfect. Graphics are at worst , the characters of this game are not to good . When your pokeballs are over , you won't get anything . In other games when any of essential things are over you can get it next day or after 24hours. Overall my experience was very bad.

It is a good game when it works and when it's fair. I.e. good concept but not for everybody, not because they wouldn't like the game but because they can't play it where they live. That's the problem: it is one of the most unfair games there is; pay to win, bugs only affect some people, location changes everything. It's also really buggy, with frequent major problems as well as constant small new bugs occurring everywhere. This game can also be really fun to play though, just got some problems.

The updates are great, quality great. But the native refresh rate is like forced to turn on. Like it is turned off but the game is smooth. And i think its not healthy, my phone gets heated like 10 minutes of playing and battery drains faster event native refresh rate is off. Niantic, please fix this issue. I want to play outside, i live in a tropical country, and my phone heats easily. It feels like im playing inside an oven while holding freshly cooked potato

Good game. Enjoy it. Helps get out for a walk. Been playing for years. Some issues, special research tasks stuck if not completed in time. Sometimes can take over a year then to complete. Log in get notification "walked 6.4km with adventure sync since last log in" yet the 5km egg I put in an incubator right after I logged in only at 4.9km?!

Niantic is the worst mobile developer company. Based on that you can expect bugs, lags, crashes, missed deadlines, broken mechanics and so on. There's a list of bugs (and I'm not talking about bug-type pokemon) that has like 500 of them, and some of them are dating back to 2016. Imagine a developer that can't fix a bug that is 6 years old? One complaint with the new stay indoors update and the double pokestop distance I still can't spin then it just says out of range or try again later. A game that does not encourages a fair play. There are some areas with a lot of pokestops and gyms while other places are empty. Trainers are forced to walk long distances to catch a few pokemon. People at hospitals could enjoy any other game but this. Completing the pokedex is almost impossible due to the "regional pokemons" (unless a person is able to afford expensive tickets to other continents). A great dissapointment.

Returning player. Downloaded the game after a few years. I noticed I couldn't collect any poké balls, and realized my inventory was full. My inventory was at 511/350. Or 2: Spend real money to expand your inventory space. 200 premium currency to expand it by 50. It's heartbreaking to see the downfall of your favorite game.

Usually a big fan of the game, but if you have a problem you will simply get no help. The "help" section is a joke and you just get automated responses from robots. Niantic has been pushing monetization a lot lately. And until recently they have not released any new "tangible" content asside from rare shinies and exclusive moves on old legendaries. FOR THOSE STARTING OUT: if your tutorial Pokémon are stuck on top of each other on your trainer avatar, turn GPS on. You need it to play anyway! -- I've been enjoying this game, with some caveats. A fun game run by a company that cares more about selling location data than their players. Having played it for 3+ months, I'm getting bored and disappointed with some elements of recent updates. At first, without the speed warning and limitation on clicking pokestops, I was hatching eggs and checking out items real fast. But now, you don't even allow us to check pokestops with a full bag. I can understand it as yet another measure of stopping cheaters, but then they can well use a new counter-measure by dropping items automatically to work around this. You don't end up stopping cheaters but you do discourage rule-abiding players. Many commuters used to check pokestops in bus or so - this is without any speed-related risk - and now this too is a good point of this game of the past. I do appreciate the recent addition of many spawn points and upcoming new features such as purported Ditto. But other than that, you guys really need to think of how to maintain the yuge revenue from us, which you won't want to miss, and how not to discourage die-hard, long-term fans. Your recent event of Lapras in Japan has effectively precluded Lapras from much of Asian places I know of, other than Japan alone. This is discouraging.

Pretty game, mainly featuring using your GPS as part of the gameplay. On the downside, it has far too many bugs, problems, etc. Various errors, multiple freezes a day requiring game restart, annoying bugs, that's all about the game. As a popular example: as part of COVID they made free PvP, well, turned out these are often unplayable (just search for "pokemon go weak connection" to understand why; and no, it's unrelated to connection). It is also terribly unoptimized: despite having a simplistic graphics game has far too many moments when it "loads" something. At first I was blaming unoptimized network usage — but no, for my gf with the same network but a newer phone these things load up much faster. That's when I figured, all these moments it indeed calculates something on my phone. To give you an example: friends list, there's nothing to process, really, it's just a menu with a few images, it gotta be instant! Well, turns out it depends on the phone. For an indirect evidence of being badly optimized: it is the most energy-hungry app I've seen so far. There's also a feature of trying to catch pokemon with your camera enabled, but without going into details, you'll most likely disable it quickly. For my gf on her brand new Xiaomi it was wrongly calculating environment, for me in turn pokemon seems not aware of it at all. The world map isn't the most correct one either. So, is it good? Well, for me it was fun to play first 30 hours I think, in part due to quests I have to complete. And I still using it for a friend who I have little other chance to make go out. Other than that, it quickly becomes boring, and the tons of bugs tend to make the game too annoying.

After playing for a week, and investing in the go plus accessory, I think I've played enough to write a review. I want to say that I haven't played a pokemon game since the gameboy advance, and Go has advanced just as far as my knowledge goes, so I'm comfortable with the Pokemon available. I find the game to be a good incentive for a large person like myself to get out of the house and walk around. Even after 500+ catches, catching a new Pokemon still feels satisfying. The gym battles are alright, and the raids are cool too, but good luck finding partners. My biggest gripe with the game is the go plus's inability to stay connected. In an 8 hour shift, I had to stop and reconnect it 11 times. It gave no warning of disconnecting. My other issue with it is that the distances traveled is COMPLETELY inaccurate. It seems like you need to travel a significant distance in a certain direction before it even begins to count as distance. There's also no reason that the go plus shouldn't work while driving. It's a button on the wrist of a hand you have on the wheel. Pressing it is less distracting than changing the radio station. As of right now, the go plus is much too unreliable to make it worth purchasing and I'm considering returning it. Besides the disconnection issue and the fact that I can walk down the road and not register that last 0.1 km i need on an egg, it's a super fun game. Edit: my go plus disconnected while I was typing this review. Edit: it's been a couple of months and I feel this needs an update. Pokemon Go is awesome. It can link with Google fit, and tracks your steps that way, so egg hatching is actually based on how much you walk instead of some arbitrary gps movement. The Go plus still disconnects constantly, but its consistent now, down to the hour. Apparently this is to save battery. Regardless, the game is constantly improving.
